Crafted with traditional interfacing, the luxurious and lightweight virgin wool suit can be worn in any season. The single-breasted jacket is distinguished by a classic cut with an elegant drape, while the regular-fit pants are enhanced by a crease along the leg, lending structure to the silhouette. The suit can be completed by a shirt and tie for a refined look, or worn with a lightweight cashmere sweater and sneakers for a more contemporary style.

products.subtitle: Black Virgin Wool Twill

paragraphs: The black jacket is an elegant piece crafted in virgin wool twill. The asymmetric construction features a double-shawl collar elevated by tonal Dior Oblique jacquard trim. It is completed by peak lapels, a chest pocket and piped side pockets. The jacket will add a modern touch to any sophisticated look.

The single-breasted coat is crafted in black cashmere. Understated and timeless, it has a mid-length cut with notched lapels and a rear vent. The style has an elegant silhouette and is a wardrobe classic.

products.title: Reversible Zipped Jacket with Book Cover Embroidery
products.subtitle: Gray Virgin Wool Twill Blend

paragraphs: The zipped jacket joins Jonathan Anderson's dream library, showcasing the first edition cover of Charles Baudelaire's Les Fleurs du Mal (Flowers of Evil), in tribute to the literary masterpiece. Crafted in gray virgin wool-blend twill, it features embroidery depicting the front cover of the book on one side, while the other has a solid design. A waist with elastic in the back and welt pockets complete the piece. The contemporary-fit jacket will lend a casual spirit to any attire.
